_doc: Which supplier parts each head-carrier screw post is made of (Idle T-5bqc3m). Post positions are never typed: robot/body/neck-head/head_holes.py measures the bore of the named spacer / shim / terminal nut on its mesh (cached in head_carrier_measured.json, so a manifest from which the spacers are already dropped still gives the same sites). group: screw family of the post; spacers / terminals / screws: manifest part names in post order; legacy_screws: manifest parts the generated screws replace; head: standard and thread of the screw (dk / k / lengths from robot/body/checks/data/hardware.json screw_standards; compute: ISO 10642 M2.5 dk / k written here, assumption). compute: pressed 304 sleeve around the post, screw into the nut. camera (owner 2026-11-22: only catalogue hardware, printable and hand-assemblable): the 8 supplier F-F standoffs are replaced by a printed column (column.ro, column.height 4.97 = the standoff's 5 mm less 0.03 mm so the board face never overlaps the column in the fit check; the screw clamp closes it) on the carrier plate with a clearance bore (column.bore_dia); a catalogue M2 brass heat-set insert (sleeve: OD 2 x ro, length) is pushed from the plate's rear face (before ROCK4D goes on) up to the bore's ledge and ends flush with the rear face; the ISO 4762 M2 screw is driven from the camera front through washer, board and column into the insert (engagement_x_d x M2 = 2.0 mm reference; length by screw_plan.choose_length, tip 0.5 mm point inside the insert). mic: the two inserts sit in two printed bosses of the head skin's inner side (boss.ro, skin_part) in place of the carrier's mic wing; the mic board rests on the boss ends (no shim), the ISO 7380-style M2 button screw is driven from the board side (before ROCK4D goes on, 0.34 mm head to ROCK4D). Insert sizes: catalogue-class M2 x 3.0 mm, OD 3.2-3.6 mm knurled (Ruthex / CNC Kitchen / Voron class); the modelled OD 3.5 is the hole size (no overlap check against the melted-in plastic). threads: ISO 724 M2 major / minor diameter of the insert's modelled bore (same values as torso_screws.THREADS). ASSUMPTIONS: no supplier data for the insert in the repo; thread modelled at the minor diameter; 1 d engagement for a steel screw in a brass thread. camera insert recess_mm: the insert's rear end sits 0.1 mm inside the plate's rear face (a heat-set insert is never exactly flush; the 0.07 mm thicker B0196 board still reaches the 1 d engagement with M2x8).

threads._doc: ISO 724 M2: major 2.0, minor 1.567 (the threaded sleeve's modelled bore); same as torso_screws.THREADS (T-bv7bwe). Assumption: no supplier data for M2 threaded press-in sleeves in the repo.
